Remark
1. Remark 1.41\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0026 ↗ hanlin:lemma-caccioppoli ↗ hanlin:cor-energy-decay For $0<\rho <r\le 1$, iteration gives \[ \int _{B_\rho }u^2\le C(\rho /r)^\mu \int _{B_r}u^2,\qquad \int _{B_\rho }|Du|^2\le C(\rho /r)^\mu \int _{B_r}|Du|^2, \] for some $\mu >0$ depending only on $n,\lambda ,\Lambda $ (the gradient exponent may be chosen in $(n-2,n)$).
